summary: Cycurion filed an 8-K disclosing the immediate resignation of director Emmit McHenry from its board, effective September 24, 2026, upon receipt of his resignation letter, with no stated reason or successor named. A companion Item 8.01 press release dated September 29, 2026 announced resolution of a John Doe defamation action in the Eastern District of Virginia, with the anonymous defendant retracting false fraud and manipulation accusations, signing an apology, barred from repeating claims and from trading CYCU stock, and required to cooperate. No deal terms were disclosed. Watch board composition, succession disclosure gaps, and any remaining anonymous-poster litigation.
